verdict.rationale: mParticle's first-party docs include a dedicated "Client SDKs" section, plus guides for sending your first event and sending events directly. It also documents HTTP and platform APIs (Warehouse Sync, Audiences) that developers can build against. The evidence is mostly section titles with little detail, so delivery is clear but thinly documented here. Missing for 10: the specific SDK languages and platforms covered, SDK reference or code-level detail, server-side SDK coverage, any AI or agent-oriented developer tooling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK experience.
